Ozanimod is a pharmaceutical drug utilized as a new treatment for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD). In 2024, it was assigned a new treatment code in the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] (LPR) [^src1]. This administrative update is significant for national healthcare tracking, as it enables patient data for ozanimod to be formally included in the DANIBD report's Indicator 5, which monitors fecal calprotectin measurements in patients receiving targeted medical treatments [^src1]. 

Ozanimod's integration into the registry is part of a broader 2024 methodological update that introduced new LPR codes for several modern biologics and JAK inhibitors. Alongside ozanimod, new codes were simultaneously established for [[upadacitinib]], [[filgotinib]], [[risankizumab]], and [[mirikizumab]] [^src1]. This systemic update supports more accurate national tracking of medical treatments and surgical quality data for IBD patients across Danish regions, addressing previous gaps in registry data for newer therapies.
